chapters.1.lds: The selected Church lesson uses this warning to discuss remaining in Christ's teaching. How does walking in received teaching connect love with responsible welcome?
chapters.1.summary: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children. He rejoices that some of her children walk in truth. He asks that they love one another, as commanded from the beginning. Love means walking by God’s commandments. Many deceivers deny that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Whoever goes beyond Christ’s teaching does not have God. They should not receive such a teacher into the house. The elder hopes to come and speak face to face.
